[sharpen][step-4] Tier-B residual-precedence (choice 0096: gate-ship with both-sides evidence + RHH kill switch + BLOCKING corpus-honest H05): increment->integer over-attractor suppression (+8); veto_shape_fallback id-residual arms a/b/c + epoch arm (+10, decline/post-veto only); binary_vocab_veto full-column feed (+2). -> ~0.88. NOTE: these are co-adapted to the CURRENT model; re-score after next-session Sense swap. BACKLOG.md #12-#16. Links memory decisive-stat-skip-is-no-go.

[sharpen][step-5][defer] Tier-C med-risk header-corroboration — each individually through the BLOCKING corpus-honest gate + kill switch; expect ~1-in-4 NO-GO. SPLIT the geography cluster (coordinate tiebreak LOW ship; country-name + admin-subdivision HIGH = the v22 country -31.5% / entity_name->region 3,752-oracle-refuted battleground, pilot in isolation, replace generator seed-list with ISO country-NAME closed set). IATA + TLD closed-set (needs IANA TLD + IATA airport lists ADDED to repo). float-epoch .0-strip + time-ish header. -> ~0.90. BACKLOG.md #17-#27.

[latency][step-3b] Batch-path plumbing (FREE, accuracy-identical, PULL FORWARD this session — it speeds the eval loop next session needs): hoist load_taxonomy + compile_validators OUT of the per-file loop (profile.rs:243,257) and reuse the one-time compiled taxonomy (profile.rs:124); read N files in ONE duckdb invocation not N spawns. ~halves the ~80ms/file batch marginal (~5-6h per 500k-file corpus pass). Card 0006; B07 audit load_taxonomy consumers. Substrate: output/next-train-research/RESEARCH.md latency section.

[sense][next-session] NEXT SESSION — Sense accuracy+speed from the clean re-scored baseline. ACCURACY: two-stage/abstaining head is the only structural lever on the 56% over-tighten mass (raw Sense ~0.60-0.66 proj; oracle ceiling 0.599; MEASURE composed pass-through — may be Sharpen-redundant). SPEED: single-potion-4M value-encoder revert (run the confounded 0.769-vs-0.794 composed A/B) + deterministic fast-path before model load (card 0006). THEN re-fit the Tier-B co-adapted vetoes vs the new model + re-score composed. DO NOT: bigger static encoder (flat 0.52), transformer (0.599 oracle/100x), naive 44-stat (0.316 collapse). Substrate: RESEARCH.md.

Corpus-pass freshness + dead-code prune (from the 2026-06-27 value audit, memory corpus-pass-value-and-staleness). Do NOT rebuild before the retrain — it would re-stale within a session. The blocking corpus-honest gate is UNAFFECTED (re-profiles from the value cache + column-intrinsic frozen oracle). ac-6 SECOND HALF — batch N files per duckdb spawn. The taxonomy-hoist half landed (commit 841cd2b: enrichment load+compile_validators hoisted out of the per-file loop, batch 26.9s->21.9s/200 files, accuracy-identical). Remaining: read_csv_input spawns ONE duckdb process per file (profile_io.rs:187); batch mode could read N files in one duckdb invocation (read_csv over a glob/UNION or a single multi-file query) to amortise process spawn + duckdb startup across the batch. Bigger/riskier (per-file error attribution, output ordering, the new parallel=false fallback + skip-and-log must compose). NOTE while there: EnumConfig::default() is rebuilt per column on both classify paths (profile.rs) — trivial loop-invariant, hoist if touching that code.
